environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on a Kubernetes cluster with a standard nginx ingress controller. The service is exposed via a LoadBalancer type Service on port 443 with TLS termination at the ingress (server-side only). No client certificate requirement. APP_SECRET_KEY is set to a 32-byte hex value shared between the application pods. The webhook endpoint is documented in the payment provider's integration guide, meaning the HMAC secret format is partially known. An attacker who compromises the webhook secret (via the payment provider's dashboard, log leak, or brute force of short keys) can forge JWT tokens for any user including admin role, since the same key material is used for both HMAC webhook verification and JWT signing.

config.kubernetes_ingress: nginx-ingress with TLS termination, no client cert auth
